excerpt: We report on the first search for nuclear recoils from dark matter ... with the XENONnT experiment which is based on a two-phase time projection chamber with a sensitive liquid xenon mass of 5.9 t. ... This leads to a minimum upper limit on the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross section of 2.58e-47 cm^2 for a WIMP mass of 28 GeV/c^2 at 90% CL.
title: First Dark Matter Search with Nuclear Recoils from the XENONnT Experiment
